original_specification.name: Steel-topped workbench
original_specification.description: Steel-topped workbench is a conceptual setting for machined parts. It combines the specified surroundings with independently managed lighting.
original_specification.representation: Close 3D surface with a separately selectable ambient environment
original_specification.geometry: Steel work surface with front fold and localized wear
original_specification.ambient_lighting: Workshop ambience with ceiling reflected in the surface
original_specification.scale_policy: Bench extent from 0.6 to 3 m; millimeter-scale scratches; preserve subject dimensions; fit the stage once to an explicit selection, never continuously rescale the CAD model
original_specification.authoring_method: Original procedural materials; licensed scans are optional future replacements after verification
validation: Keep grain, joints and pores at physical scale.
Inspect ground contact and avoid illumination baked into texture maps.
